name: Prop Hide
hook: Be the lamp. Don't move. Don't squeak.
how: Hiders turn into crates, lamps, plants and chairs and hide among the real ones while the seekers count. Seekers tap props to tag them: a hider is found and joins the seekers, a real prop leaves you dizzy for a moment. Find every hider before time runs out.
controls: WASD to walk, click a prop to become it or tag it, Q change, R turn, or the touch stick and buttons
uses: The host's browser picks the seekers, checks every tag and makes hiders squeak; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bot hiders pick spots next to look-alikes; bot seekers search, listen and sometimes tag a real lamp.
Every prop, walker and squeak is the same for everyone.
Which prop is a player is in the room state, so someone digging in their browser's dev tools could spot the hiders. Play it fair.
The most points anyone scored in one round.
ideas: Set it in a spooky castle with suits of armor
Let hiders throw a decoy that squeaks somewhere else
Give seekers a radar that beeps faster near a hider
